quests.instruction: Ben is putting on his socks and his shoes. Which comes first?
quests.correctAnswer: Socks 🧦
quests.explanation: Socks go inside the shoes, so they must go on first.
quests.funFact: Putting a sock on while sitting down is easier than standing.

quests.instruction: Zoe is getting dressed for school in a T-shirt and a sweater. Which goes on first?
quests.correctAnswer: T-shirt 👕
quests.hint: The sweater goes over the shirt.
quests.explanation: Layers are put on from the inside out. The T-shirt sits under the sweater, so it goes on first.
quests.funFact: Clothes closest to your skin are called base layers.

quests.instruction: Which is the last thing you put on before running out into the snow?
quests.correctAnswer: Mittens 🧤
quests.explanation: You can put mittens on at the door after your coat. Items worn under other clothes go on first.
quests.funFact: Mittens on strings can stop you losing them.

quests.instruction: Noor wears a T-shirt, a sweater, and a rain jacket. Which is the outer layer?
quests.correctAnswer: Rain jacket 🧥
quests.explanation: The outermost layer is the one on the outside. A rain jacket on top shields the layers below from the rain.
quests.funFact: Layers underneath stay drier when the outer layer is waterproof.

quests.instruction: Why do we put a coat on after a sweater instead of before?
quests.correctAnswer: The coat is bigger and fits over the sweater 🧥
options: The coat is bigger and fits over the sweater 🧥
The sweater is too big to fit under it 🧶
The coat should touch the skin first 👕
quests.explanation: A coat is larger, so it fits over layers. A sweater under a coat stays warm and dry.
quests.funFact: A snug sweater under a coat stays warm and does not bunch up.

quests.instruction: Which item must go under a jacket to make the layering work?
quests.correctAnswer: A shirt 👕
quests.hint: Shirts stay closest to the skin.
quests.explanation: A shirt is the base layer under the jacket. Putting another jacket under it would be too bulky.
quests.funFact: Many jackets have a smooth lining that slides easily over a shirt.

quests.instruction: Mia is dressing for a snowy day. Which order makes the most sense?
quests.correctAnswer: Socks, snow pants, boots, coat, mittens 🧤
options: Mittens, coat, boots, snow pants, socks 🧦
Socks, snow pants, boots, coat, mittens 🧤
quests.explanation: Socks go on first, then pants over them, boots over the pants, then the coat and mittens last.
quests.funFact: Pulling pants over boots can let snow in, so put pants over boots in some designs.

quests.instruction: Why are mittens usually put on last?
quests.correctAnswer: Hands are free to do other things first ✋
options: Hands are free to do other things first ✋
They take the longest to put on ⏳
quests.hint: You need your hands to zip and tie.
quests.explanation: Mittens make it harder to zip, tie, or button, so you put them on at the end.
quests.funFact: Clips or strings help prevent losing mittens.

quests.instruction: Tariq puts on a hat, then realizes he forgot his sweater. What is the problem?
quests.correctAnswer: The hat must come off to pull the sweater on 🧢
options: The hat will get wet inside the sweater 💧
The hat must come off to pull the sweater on 🧢
The hat will make the sweater too tight 🧶
quests.hint: The sweater goes over the head.
quests.explanation: A pullover sweater passes over your head, so the hat has to come off first.
quests.funFact: Put on pullover tops before hats.

quests.instruction: Priya comes inside from a snowy walk. What should she take off first?
quests.correctAnswer: Wet outer layers like coat and boots ❄️
options: Wet outer layers like coat and boots ❄️
quests.hint: Wet layers should come off first.
quests.explanation: Wet outer clothes make you cold inside, so remove those first and hang them to dry.
quests.funFact: Snow melts as soon as it enters a warm room.

quests.instruction: After running, Kai feels hot while wearing three layers. Which layer should come off?
quests.correctAnswer: The outermost layer 🧥
quests.explanation: The outer layer is the easiest to remove and cools him fast without exposing skin.
quests.funFact: Take layers off before you sweat a lot.

quests.instruction: Why do you remove boots at the door when they are muddy?
quests.correctAnswer: So mud doesn't spread across the floor 🚪
options: So the boots stay muddy longer 🪣
So mud doesn't spread across the floor 🚪
quests.hint: Focus on what's on the bottom.
quests.explanation: Taking muddy boots off at the door keeps the floor clean.
quests.funFact: Boot trays catch dripping melted snow.

quests.instruction: For a freezing day, which three-layer plan makes the most sense?
quests.correctAnswer: Warm base layer, sweater, winter coat 🧥
options: Warm base layer, sweater, winter coat 🧥
quests.explanation: Each layer traps a bit of warm air. The coat on the outside blocks wind and cold.
quests.funFact: Layers also let you take one off if you get hot.

quests.instruction: Which layer is meant to touch the skin in cold weather?
quests.correctAnswer: Soft, snug base layer 👕
quests.explanation: A soft base layer sits against skin, keeps comfort, and holds the other layers in place.
quests.funFact: Base layers are sometimes called thermal underwear.

quests.instruction: Leo wears a hoodie under his coat and notices his coat is hard to zip. What's the likely reason?
quests.correctAnswer: The layers together are too bulky 🧥
options: The coat's zipper is too long 🤐
The layers together are too bulky 🧥
quests.explanation: Several thick layers take up room. A coat that fits over them needs to be a little bigger.
quests.funFact: Very bulky layers can restrict movement.

quests.instruction: Why is a damp sweater under a dry coat a problem on a cold day?
quests.correctAnswer: Damp layers pull heat from your body 💧
options: Damp layers pull heat from your body 💧
Damp layers make your coat shrink 📉
Damp layers make you too warm 🔥
quests.hint: Focus on what water does to warmth.
quests.explanation: Water carries heat away from your skin, so a damp layer makes you cold even under a dry coat.
quests.funFact: Keeping the layer next to your skin dry is important.

quests.instruction: What should Ravi do if his inside shirt gets wet from sweat while sledding?
quests.correctAnswer: Change into a dry shirt when he stops 👕
options: Take off his coat and sit still ❄️
Zip his coat up over the wet shirt 🧥
Change into a dry shirt when he stops 👕
quests.explanation: Dry clothes help keep you warm once you rest.
quests.funFact: Sweaty clothes feel cold when you stop moving.

quests.instruction: Which layer should be waterproof when it's raining?
quests.correctAnswer: The outside layer 🧥
quests.explanation: The outermost layer meets the rain, so it needs to be waterproof to protect everything underneath.
quests.funFact: Waterproof outer layers are sometimes called shells.

quests.instruction: Aisha steps in from the rain wearing a wet jacket and wet boots. What is the best first step?
quests.correctAnswer: Take off the wet jacket and boots at the door 🚪
options: Take off the wet jacket and boots at the door 🚪
Hang the wet jacket on her bed to dry 🛏️
Keep the wet boots on so her feet stay warm 🥾
quests.hint: Wet things shouldn't go through the house.
quests.explanation: Removing wet outer layers at the door keeps the rest of the home dry and helps her warm up.
quests.funFact: A coat hook by the door helps wet gear dry.

quests.instruction: When you take your wet raincoat off, where does it dry best?
quests.correctAnswer: Hanging up where air can move ♻️
options: Hanging up where air can move ♻️
quests.explanation: Air circulation helps clothing dry quickly and prevents bad smells.
quests.funFact: Hanging coat sleeves out helps them dry.

quests.instruction: After a rainy walk, Tomás's socks are wet but his sweater is dry. What does he change first?
quests.correctAnswer: His wet socks 🧦
quests.explanation: Wet socks make his feet cold, so swapping them for dry socks is the most useful change.
quests.funFact: Feet lose heat quickly when wet.

quests.instruction: Lina's shoelaces are untied and she is about to run. What should she do first?
quests.correctAnswer: Tie her laces 🪢
quests.hint: What could make you trip while running?
quests.explanation: Untied laces can trip you. Tie them before running.
quests.funFact: A double knot is more secure.

quests.instruction: Yuki wants to wear a tight turtleneck and a loose cardigan. Which goes on first?
quests.correctAnswer: Turtleneck 👕
quests.hint: Fitted layers go under loose ones.
quests.explanation: A fitted turtleneck goes on first with a looser cardigan over it, which would otherwise bunch up.
quests.funFact: Cardigans open at the front, so they go over other tops.

quests.instruction: Why do we zip a jacket after putting it on, not before?
quests.correctAnswer: It's easier to pull on and then zip up 🤐
options: It's easier to pull on and then zip up 🤐
It keeps the jacket from getting dirty 🧼
Zippers don't work before you put it on 🔧
quests.explanation: Slipping a jacket on and then zipping up is easier than zipping first, since the opening needs to be wide enough to get in.
quests.funFact: Pullover jackets don't need a zipper.

quests.instruction: Omar put his coat on and then tried to pull a sweater over it. What went wrong?
quests.correctAnswer: The sweater should go under the coat 🧶
options: The sweater is too small for a coat 📏
The sweater should go under the coat 🧶
The coat should go on after the hat 🧢
quests.explanation: Sweaters go under coats. The order is inner layers first and outer layers last.
quests.funFact: Dressing from inner to outer layers keeps everything neat.

quests.instruction: Tomás tucked his thick sweater into his jeans, and it bunches up uncomfortably. What is a better choice?
quests.correctAnswer: Leave the sweater out over his jeans 🧶
options: Leave the sweater out over his jeans 🧶
Tuck it in tighter with a belt 🥋
quests.hint: Thick fabric is bulky inside a waistband.
quests.explanation: Thick sweaters usually feel better worn outside, because tucking them in makes bulky bunches at the waist.
quests.funFact: Thin tops tuck in more easily than thick ones.

quests.instruction: Why shouldn't you wear wet socks under dry boots?
quests.correctAnswer: Feet will get cold and may get blisters 🥶
options: Boots will get warmer from the water 🔥
Socks will dry the boots out 🧦
Feet will get cold and may get blisters 🥶
quests.explanation: Wet socks pull heat from your feet and rub, which can cause blisters.
quests.funFact: Spare dry socks in your bag help.

quests.instruction: Diego is going sledding. Which sequence is best?
quests.correctAnswer: Base layer, sweater, snow jacket 🧥
quests.explanation: Base layer first, then sweater, then the snow jacket on the outside.
quests.funFact: Layers are like onion skins.

quests.instruction: Why is wearing a thin jacket over a thick sweater better than the reverse?
quests.correctAnswer: The jacket blocks wind and the sweater holds heat 🌬️
options: Both layers do exactly the same job ⚖️
The jacket blocks wind and the sweater holds heat 🌬️
The sweater blocks wind and the jacket holds heat 🧶
quests.hint: One does wind, one does warmth.
quests.explanation: The sweater holds warmth and the jacket on the outside blocks wind, so each does its job.
quests.funFact: Wind removes warm air from around your body.

quests.instruction: Zoya has finished dressing for cold weather, but her hands are cold. What is missing?
quests.correctAnswer: Gloves or mittens 🧤
quests.explanation: Hands have no layer yet. Gloves or mittens are the missing piece.
quests.funFact: Fingers cool down quickly.
